items.title: Waive Notice - Amend Meeting Start Time
notes:
Prior to beginning the Special Council meeting this date, it was noted Council was being requested to Waive Notice to amend the start time of the meeting this date.

To approve the amended start time, 2/3 of the Whole of Council is required.

items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:59 p.m this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 5:03 p.m.

motions.item_title: Waive Notice - Amend Meeting Start Time
motions.text: "That pursuant to Section 25.4.4 (g) of Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code, Council waive notice to amend the start time of the special meeting to commence immediately rather than at 5:30 p.m.”
